title: Quantum PCP: a constant promise gap for local Hamiltonians
question: Are there constants $k$ and $\varepsilon>0$ for which the following promise problem is QMA-hard? The input is $H=\frac1m\sum_{i=1}^m H_i$ on $n$ qubits, with each term acting on at most $k$ qubits and $0\preceq H_i\preceq I$. Distinguish $\lambda_{\min}(H)\le a$ from $\lambda_{\min}(H)\ge b$, promised $b-a\ge\varepsilon$. The reduction must be efficient. This is the normalized Hamiltonian formulation.
